evals.prompt: Aweti now has full recall but compile time has doubled after adding several gated phonological rules. Give me three different FST construction candidates and tell me which is best.
evals.expected_output: Characterizes the baseline, extracts the gate/rewrite interaction graph, provides three structurally different plans over the five primitives, names bounded search and correctness gates, and returns a bounded optimum or Pareto frontier rather than an unsupported global winner.

evals.prompt: A new grammar has optional templates, a rule cascade, and a 50 MB payload. I want it to automatically choose a recipe when it is imported. Design the registry entry and rollout plan.
evals.expected_output: Separates documented, validated, and automated recipes; includes finite parameters, feature extraction, builder/evidence prerequisites, wall-clock and structural objectives, capability/recall/conformance gates, and does not claim that automatic planning already exists.

evals.prompt: We have eight plausible compose orders and several gate partitions, but each full build takes 20 minutes. How should we search the combinations without losing correctness?
evals.expected_output: Selects or compares the three search methods, explains budgeted sequential allocation for this expensive uncertain space, preserves real Plan representation and all correctness gates, and states stopping/confidence criteria plus an honest Pareto result contract.
